title: Consideration Circuits: Depth Separation and Universality Beyond a Single Softmax
abstract: arXiv:2610.04143v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Most feature-based choice models, classical and deep, score items and apply a single softmax. We introduce consideration circuits (CC), feature-based models of multi-stage choice defined by directed acyclic graphs of multinomial logit (MNL) units. Source units assign probabilities to menu items, and internal units combine predecessor distributions using MNL weights computed from their probability-weighted feature summaries. On a three-item compromise task with fixed non-collinear features, menu-independent random-utility models (RUM), including a single MNL unit, suffer an error bounded away from zero. For CC, in contrast, we establish a sharp depth--norm separation: increasing depth from $2$ to $3$ reduces the optimal maximum taste-vector norm for error $\epsilon$ from $\Theta(\log(1/\epsilon)/\epsilon)$ to $\Theta(\log(1/\epsilon))$. translated_title: 考虑电路：超越单一Softmax的深度分离与普适性
translated_abstract: 大多数基于特征的选择模型——无论是经典的还是深度的——都是对物品打分后应用单一的softmax。我们提出了“考虑电路”，这是一类基于特征的多阶段选择模型，由多项logit（MNL）单元构成的有向无环图定义。源单元为菜单中的物品分配概率，内部单元则利用由其前驱的概率加权特征摘要计算出的MNL权重来组合前驱分布。在一个具有固定非共线特征的三物品折中任务上，与菜单无关的随机效用模型（RUM），包括单个MNL单元，其误差存在一个不趋于零的下界。相比之下，对于考虑电路，我们建立了一个尖锐的深度-范数分离结果：将深度从2增加到3，可将达到误差ε所需的最优最大品味向量范数从Θ(log(1/ε)/ε)降低到Θ(log(1/ε))。深度为2的下界对任意宽度和与菜单无关的路由偏置均成立，而一个fi……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 论文提出由多项logit（MNL）单元构成的有向无环图所定义的“考虑电路”多阶段选择模型，并证明了尖锐的深度-范数分离定理：深度从2增至3时，逼近误差ε所需的品味向量范数从Θ(log(1/ε)/ε)降至Θ(log(1/ε))，而包括单一MNL在内的菜单无关随机效用模型在折中任务上误差存在不可消除的下界，从而在表达能力与结构上严格超越了单一softmax模型。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces consideration circuits (CC), multi-stage choice models defined by directed acyclic graphs of multinomial logit units, and proves a sharp depth-norm separation—raising depth from 2 to 3 reduces the optimal taste-vector norm for error ε from Θ(log(1/ε)/ε) to Θ(log(1/ε))—while menu-independent RUMs including a single MNL unit provably suffer non-vanishing error on compromise tasks, establishing expressivity beyond a single softmax.
